full_judgment: 2. It is stated that the petitioner a bonafide businessman is a permanent resident of village Kalagachia under police station Golachipa in the District of Patuakhali. It is also stated that in 1950 the present Patuakhali District was a sub-division and there were several Union Boards under the said Patuakhali sub-division and No:4 Kalagachia Union Board was one of them, subsequently, the said union was renamed as Kharizzaman Union. Thereafter Kharizzaman Union and its adjacent Lamna Union were amalgamated and renamed as Bakulbaria Union.
